maturity: signal k executes open k+1; outcome open k+2; require k+2 < cutoff
confidence: Frozen training cell means; radius max(2.58 training date SE, absolute calibration bias + 2.58 calibration date SE); at least 20 dates in each; assign only if entire interval in one absolute economic tier; else UNKNOWN
pass_rule: Every scenario: coverage >=0.5; all five predicted tiers >=20 observations; conditional exact EV-tier accuracy >=0.7; each EV-tier recall including abstentions >=0.5; false GREAT / true TERRIBLE <=0.01; five realized tier means strictly monotone. Null may pass safety via abstention but cannot establish discrimination. Overall five-way claim requires all scenarios.
limitations: Synthetic EV ground truth is evaluator-only conditional mean, distinct from individual realized return. No causal learner can guarantee recognition under unannounced regime inversion. 2.58-SE intervals are diagnostic, not a formal dependence-robust guarantee.
